title: metadata-protocol: registry write-through faults for non-object types are only logged, so revertCommit cannot report them
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRsWwTRkuRCyQwvpAG

Loose end of PR #33805 (#33563, merged 11-15), the PR's one loose-ends card under R5. It is behaviour-changing, so it was not folded.

## 维护者速读

- 问题:回滚提交现在会把“写入后出错”的条目列入失败列表,但只覆盖对象类型。视图、权限等其他类型在写入注册表时出错,只记一条日志,回滚仍然报告成功。
- 影响:回滚了视图或权限、但注册表没更新时,用户看到“成功”,实际页面还是旧的。
- 建议:让这几个分支把错误返回给调用方,和对象类型一致。

## Where

`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-registry-hydration.ts`:
- `applyRegistryWriteThrough`'s non-object branches catch and log their faults.
- `restoreArtifactRegistryView`'s heal does the same.

The file is shared with save and publish, so a view or permission write-through fault stays invisible to `revertCommit`, which since #33805 reports object write-through refusals in `failed[]`.

## Wanted

The non-object branches return a refusal the caller can read, instead of only logging. `revertCommit` then puts the item into `failed[]` with the row state named, as for objects. Check what save and publish do with the new refusal: they must not start failing where they succeed today without saying so in the changeset. Pins per type with an ablation.

## Reader

`domain:server` area S5 (E1b: protocol-registry-hydration.ts, not protocol.ts). p2. Clause-② to be judged by the claim: a save door that newly refuses is narrowing.

## Dedupe

Searched `applyRegistryWriteThrough`, `restoreArtifactRegistryView`, `write-through fault logged`: only #33563 and PR #33805.
